name: design-critique
title: Design Critique
description: Extremely strict visual review against ApexWeb standards; rejects generic, templated or over-decorated work.
when_to_use: After any design or build step.
instructions: Reject when hierarchy is weak, spacing inconsistent, typography undisciplined, effects decorative, or the page looks like a template.
Use rendered evidence (screenshots, measurements, anti-slop scan) rather than impressions.
Revision instructions name the section/selector and the exact change.
